name: Witarist AI Chat & Lead Capture
author: witarist

sections.description:
Witarist AI Chat & Lead Capture adds an AI chat widget and live chat to your WordPress site that answers visitors 24/7 and turns them into leads — trained on your own content, set up in minutes, no code.

This plugin is the official WordPress client for ProChat, the AI chat and lead-capture service operated by Witarist (https://useprochat.com). It loads the chat widget on your site and lets you manage appearance, your knowledge base, and incoming leads directly inside wp-admin. Your account, conversations, knowledge base and leads live in the ProChat service; the plugin connects WordPress to it.

Most chat plugins go silent the moment you’re offline. The AI assistant reads your website and documents and answers questions instantly, around the clock — then captures the visitor’s name, email, and phone so you never lose a lead. It’s live chat, an AI chatbot, and a lead-generation tool in one.

Features

  • AI chatbot trained on your content — import your pages or upload PDFs, Word docs and FAQs; the AI answers from your real information.
  • 24/7 lead capture — qualifies visitors and collects contact details even after hours.
  • Hot / Warm / Cold lead scoring — know which leads to follow up first.
  • Live chat when you want it — jump into any conversation in real time from your dashboard.
  • One-line install — activate in WordPress and go live in minutes.
  • Customizable widget — brand color, greeting, welcome message, and left/right placement.
  • Built-in test mode — preview what the AI will say before it goes live.

Perfect for agencies, service businesses, clinics, law firms, real estate, e-commerce and small businesses that want more leads from their existing website traffic.

External services

This plugin connects to ProChat, an external AI chat and lead-capture service operated by Witarist, to provide all of its functionality. The service powers the chat widget and stores your account, knowledge base, conversations and leads.

Data is sent to the service (https://useprochat.com) in these cases:

  • On the front end — the chat widget script is loaded from the service on pages where the widget is shown. When a visitor uses the chat, the messages they send and basic page context (such as the current page URL) are sent to the service so the AI can reply and a lead can be captured.
  • In wp-admin — when you connect or configure the plugin, the following is sent to the service’s API: the email address and password you enter (used once to obtain an access token), your site URL, and any knowledge-base content you add, import or upload. After connecting, only a connection token (kept server-side) and your widget ID are stored in WordPress.

The service is required for the plugin to work. By using it you agree to the ProChat Terms of Service and Privacy Policy:

  • Terms of Service: https://useprochat.com/terms
  • Privacy Policy: https://useprochat.com/privacy
sections.installation:
1. Upload the witarist-ai-chat-lead-capture folder to /wp-content/plugins/, or install the .zip via Plugins → Add New → Upload Plugin.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins menu in WordPress.
  3. Open Witarist Chat in the admin menu and click Activate (or connect an existing account).
  4. That’s it — the AI chat widget is live on your site.
sections.faq:
Do I need an account first?

No. “Activate” creates a ProChat account for you from inside WordPress and verifies your email with a code. You can set a password to log in at useprochat.com later, but it isn’t required.

What does the AI answer from?

Your own content. Import your website pages or upload documents (PDF, Word, .md, .txt) and the assistant answers visitors from that knowledge base.

Can I edit what the assistant knows?

Yes. The Knowledge base tab lets you view, edit, add, upload and delete entries, and a built-in Test chat lets you preview answers before going live.

Where is my data stored?

Conversations, knowledge base and leads live in your ProChat account on the external service (see External services above). The plugin stores only a connection token (server-side) and your widget ID.

Does it slow down my site?

No. The widget loads asynchronously and the processing happens on the service’s servers, not your WordPress host.
sections.changelog:
1.2.1

  • Security hardening: the plugin now validates the service URL against an allow-list of the official ProChat host, so it cannot be pointed at an arbitrary domain.

1.2.0

  • Renamed to “Witarist AI Chat & Lead Capture” and documented the external ProChat service the plugin connects to.
  • Connecting an existing account now reuses the widget already registered for this site’s domain instead of creating a new, empty one.

1.1.1

  • Expandable knowledge base entries with inline edit and delete; more reliable error handling.

1.1.0

  • Email verification when creating a new account from WordPress; document upload and a built-in Test chat preview.

1.0.0

  • Initial release: account linking, widget injection, appearance, knowledge base, and leads inside wp-admin.
